title: Thermal shutdown
text: The controller should stop charging quickly when the pad gets too hot.

title: Lateral displacement detection
text: The alignment monitor shall detect a lateral displacement greater than 15 mm.

title: Voltage sampling
text: The telemetry service shall record charging voltage at least once every 1 s.

title: Communication error handling
text: Communication errors shall be handled appropriately.

title: Authentication interlock
text: The controller shall prevent power transfer when authentication status is INVALID.

title: Vehicle detection sequence
text: The system shall detect the vehicle and shall initiate the alignment sequence.

title: Overtemperature response
text: When pad temperature exceeds 80 degC, the controller shall disable power transfer within 100 ms.

title: Charging-state display
text: The monitoring dashboard will display the latest charging state.

title: Diagnostic information
text: The control unit shall provide sufficient diagnostic information.

title: Event retention
text: The event logger shall retain the most recent 10000 charging events.

title: Isolation check
text: The isolation monitor shall complete its startup self-test within 2 s.

title: Insulation interlock
text: If insulation resistance is below the configured safety threshold, the controller shall inhibit power transfer.

title: Firmware identification
text: The controller shall expose its firmware version through the diagnostic interface.

title: Authentication retry
text: The connector may retry authentication after a timeout.

title: Authentication lockout
text: After 3 consecutive authentication failures, the controller shall block further attempts for 60 s.

title: Rain operation
text: It shall operate normally during rain.

title: Communication-loss logging
text: The controller shall record a diagnostic event within 1 s after loss of communication.

title: Status and fault handling
text: The user interface shall show charging status and the communication module shall log communication faults.
